The requirements for submitting an audit report are based upon the total amount of Federal financial assistance expended during the Town’s Fiscal Year from all Federal sources as follows:

- (i) If the Town expends $300,000 or more in Federal financial assistance per Fiscal Year it shall submit an audit performed in accordance with the requirements of OMB Circular A-133.

- (iii) If the Town expends less than $300,000 in Federal financial assistance per Fiscal Year and has an outstanding Rural Development loan balance of less than $300,000 it may, with Rural Development approval, submit a management report in lieu of an audit report.
